fieldDescriptions.SrcIpAddr: Source IP address for the network session.
fieldDescriptions.DstIpAddr: Destination IP address for the network session.
fieldDescriptions.NetworkProtocol: Transport protocol observed for the session.
fieldDescriptions.ApplicationProtocol: Application protocol inferred for the session.
fieldDescriptions.NetworkDirection: Traffic direction relative to the monitored environment.
fieldDescriptions.Action: Firewall action applied to the session.
fieldDescriptions.BytesSent: Number of bytes sent during the session.
fieldDescriptions.BytesReceived: Number of bytes received during the session.
fieldDescriptions.DnsQuery: DNS name associated with the session when available.
fieldDescriptions.Url: HTTP or HTTPS URL associated with the session when available.
fieldDescriptions.UserName: User or service identity associated with the session when available.
fieldDescriptions.DeviceName: Network device that recorded the session.
fieldDescriptions.RuleName: Network policy or firewall rule applied to the session.
